2607.00937.title: Persona Non Grata: LLM Persona-Driven Generations in MCQA are Unstable in Distinct Dimensions
2607.00937.paper_summary: Persona-driven generations (PDGs) have seen prolific use in research and industry applications, where a large language model (LLM) takes on a 'persona' while completing some task. While persona expressed through free-form text (like dialogue) has substantial work investigating stability or consistency, relatively, persona expressed in non-text-heavy outputs (like in multiple-choice question answering, or MCQA) is often overlooked. We work to address this gap, seeking to understand the instability of LLM PDGs in MCQA tasks. We develop three metrics investigating the performance, outcome, and question correctness stability, evaluating three distinct dimensions. Using these metrics, we find that instability varies consistently between model families and model size, and across question domains, with math/commonsense questions leading to greater instability. We also find task prompt format introduces more prediction instability than other hyperparameters, like temperature. Finally, we find that instability is related to task accuracy, and using our instability metrics, find different experimental settings that result in different best and worst personas for tasks, despite their similarity. This reveals the importance of checking hyperparameter instability in PDGs.
2607.00937.paper_summary_zh: Persona 驅動的生成 (PDGs) 在研究和工業應用中得到了廣泛使用，其中大型語言模型 (LLM) 在完成某些任務時扮演「角色」。雖然通過自由形式文本（如對話）表達的角色在穩定性或一致性方面有大量研究，但相對而言，表達在非文本密集型輸出（如多選題回答，或 MCQA）中的角色卻常常被忽視。我們致力於填補這一空白，試圖理解 LLM PDGs 在 MCQA 任務中的不穩定性。我們開發了三個指標來調查性能、結果和問題正確性穩定性，評估三個不同的維度。使用這些指標，我們發現不穩定性在模型家族和模型大小之間，以及在問題領域之間持續變化，數學/常識問題導致更大的不穩定性。我們還發現任務提示格式比其他超參數（如溫度）引入了更多的預測不穩定性。最後，我們發現不穩定性與任務準確性有關，並使用我們的不穩定性指標，發現不同的實驗設置導致任務的最佳和最差角色不同，儘管它們相似。這揭示了檢查 PDGs 中超參數不穩定性的重要性。
2607.00937.author: César Guerra-Solano et.al.
